tbesh_html:
1) to place, set, stand, set or station oneself, present oneself
1a) (Hithpael) to station oneself, take one's stand, stand, present oneself, stand with someone
Aramaic equivalent: ye.tsav (יְצַב "to know" H3321)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to place (any thing so as to stay); reflexively, to station, offer, continue
strongs_1890.kjv_def: present selves, remaining, resort, set (selves), (be able to, can, with-) stand (fast, forth, -ing, still, up).
